microsoft_365_tenant_setup.marketingCopy: A clean Microsoft 365 tenant is the foundation of everything else - and most tenants are a tangle of default settings, wrong licenses, and insecure configurations from day one. The Microsoft 365 Tenant Setup provisions or cleanly configures a new tenant foundation the right way. We set up your domain, create a proper user and group structure, assign the right licenses, configure email and DNS records, enforce MFA and basic security baselines from the start, and document the whole tenant so it's manageable instead of mysterious. Starting with a properly configured tenant avoids the cleanup, security gaps, and confusion that plague businesses that set up Microsoft 365 on their own.
bestFor: New businesses setting up Microsoft 365 for the first time
Organizations migrating from another provider who want a clean start
Businesses whose tenant was set up hastily and needs a proper foundation
Companies that want MFA, security, and structure in place from day one
whatIsIncluded: User, group, and license structure design and setup
SharePoint, Teams, and OneDrive foundational setup
customerOutcomes: A properly structured Microsoft 365 tenant with correct licenses and users
Email, domains, and DNS working correctly from the start
Security basics like MFA configured before users arrive
Documented, manageable tenant structure instead of an inherited mess

microsoft_365_tenant_cleanup.marketingCopy: Over the years, Microsoft 365 tenants accumulate stale users, wrong licenses, orphaned groups, mailbox delegation that shouldn't exist, and insecure collaboration settings - often left behind by former employees and past IT providers. The Microsoft 365 Tenant Cleanup systematically works through your tenant to remove what shouldn't be there. We identify and disable stale accounts, reclaim wasted licenses, clean up groups and Teams no longer in use, review and remove unnecessary mailbox delegation and shared mailbox permissions, and lock down external sharing and collaboration settings that expose data. Every change is documented and approved, so you end up with a leaner, safer, less expensive tenant.
bestFor: Businesses that have had employees, providers, or contractors come and go
Organizations paying for licenses nobody uses
Companies concerned about wide-open sharing or old delegation
Businesses that inherited a tenant and want it cleaned up properly
whatIsIncluded: Stale user and license audit with cost reclaim
Mailbox delegation and shared mailbox permission review
External sharing and collaboration setting lockdown
customerOutcomes: A tenant free of stale users, unused licenses, and orphaned groups
Lower monthly Microsoft 365 costs from reclaimed licenses
Reduced data exposure from cleaned-up sharing and delegation
A documented, managed tenant instead of an accumulated mess

microsoft_365_monthly_admin.marketingCopy: Microsoft 365 needs ongoing administration - new users, departing users, license changes, mailbox issues, Teams management, and security settings - and most small businesses have nobody doing it consistently. The Microsoft 365 Monthly Admin service provides ongoing, predictable administration of your tenant. Each month we handle user and license changes, troubleshoot mailbox and Teams issues, review and clean up access, apply security and compliance settings, and keep your tenant documented. You get the benefits of a dedicated Microsoft 365 administrator without hiring one full-time. It's a recurring service that keeps your tenant running, secure, and well-maintained month after month.
bestFor: Businesses that rely on Microsoft 365 but have no dedicated admin
Organizations that juggle admin tasks between busy staff members
Companies that want proactive tenant maintenance rather than reactive fixes
Businesses that want their tenant managed consistently and documented
whatIsIncluded: Monthly user, license, and group administration
Mailbox, Teams, and SharePoint troubleshooting and support
customerOutcomes: Microsoft 365 administration handled consistently every month
User lifecycle managed properly from onboarding to offboarding
Security and compliance settings kept current
A documented, well-run tenant with a predictable monthly cost

microsoft_365_security_baseline.marketingCopy: Microsoft 365 comes with security defaults, but 'default' isn't 'secure enough' for most businesses - especially with insurance and compliance expectations rising. The Microsoft 365 Security Baseline establishes practical, foundational controls in your tenant: MFA enforced, admin roles reviewed, legacy authentication blocked, email protection configured, and sharing locked down to safe defaults. We implement the baseline settings that matter most for a small business, verify they work without disrupting your users, and document everything. This is the tenant hardening every Microsoft 365 business should have - implemented, tested, and documented.
bestFor: Businesses that want Microsoft 365 security hardened beyond default settings
Organizations preparing for insurance or compliance reviews
Companies that have never reviewed MFA or admin roles in their tenant
Businesses that want documented security baselines in place
whatIsIncluded: MFA enforcement and Conditional Access baseline
Admin role review and least-privilege adjustment
External sharing lockdown to safe defaults
customerOutcomes: MFA enforced and legacy authentication blocked in your tenant
Admin roles reviewed and reduced to least privilege
Email protection and sharing configured to safe baselines
Documented security baseline evidence for insurance and compliance

microsoft_365_backup_setup.marketingCopy: Microsoft 365 does not fully back up your data - it provides retention and recycling, but accidental deletion, malicious insider actions, and ransomware can still destroy mail, OneDrive files, and SharePoint content permanently. The Microsoft 365 Backup Setup configures a proper backup solution for Exchange Online, SharePoint, and OneDrive so you have real point-in-time recovery. We select an appropriate backup platform, configure automated backup of your mailboxes, sites, and files, set sensible retention, and test a restore so you know it actually works. Your Microsoft 365 data finally gets the protection your business already assumes it has.
bestFor: Businesses that assume Microsoft 365 protects their data (it doesn't fully)
Organizations concerned about accidental deletion or ransomware
Companies that need email, SharePoint, and OneDrive recoverable beyond Microsoft's retention
Businesses preparing for insurance that requires backup evidence
whatIsIncluded: M365 backup platform selection and setup
Mail, site, and file restore walkthrough
customerOutcomes: Real, automated backup of your Microsoft 365 data
Point-in-time recovery for mail, files, and sites
Verified restore capability instead of assumed protection
Backup evidence for insurance and compliance

The Microsoft 365 Migration Lite is designed for small businesses migrating a modest number of mailboxes, a domain, or a small file set - with planning, cutover, and validation handled professionally. We plan the migration to minimize disruption, migrate mailboxes and data with the right tools, configure the new environment, and validate that mail and files arrived intact. We handle the technical cutover steps that commonly break, so your team moves to Microsoft 365 without lost email, missing files, or confused users.

Organizations moving email and domain from another provider
Companies with a modest amount of data who want a managed migration
Businesses that want cutover handled by professionals

Post-migration validation of mail and files
customerOutcomes: A completed migration to Microsoft 365 with minimal disruption
Mail, domain, and data validated as intact

microsoft_365_migration_full.marketingCopy: A full migration to Microsoft 365 involves discovery, communication, cutover, and post-migration validation - and when it's done poorly, it costs lost email, disrupted business, and frustrated staff. We conduct discovery and planning, design the target structure, communicate the migration to users so nobody is surprised, execute the migration in phases, perform cutover with minimized disruption, and validate everything post-migration. microsoft_365_license_optimization.marketingCopy: Most small businesses pay for Microsoft 365 licenses they don't use or need - and the opposite is also common: users on the wrong plan, missing features they could use, or paying extra for products nobody touches. The Microsoft 365 License Optimization reviews every license assignment in your tenant against actual usage. We analyze which users are inactive, which licenses are wasted, and which plans are mismatched to job needs. You get a clear picture of what you're paying for versus what you're using, with recommendations that reduce cost or improve fit. For most businesses this review pays for itself in the first month of reclaimed licenses.

Organizations with inactive users still holding licenses
Companies unsure whether users are on the right plan
Businesses preparing for renewal who want to right-size

customerOutcomes: A clear picture of Microsoft 365 spend versus actual usage

shared_mailbox_cleanup.marketingCopy: Shared mailboxes quietly accumulate permissions, delegation, and stale access - former employees who can still read them, users with Full Access who shouldn't have it, and mailboxes that nobody uses anymore. The Shared Mailbox Cleanup reviews every shared mailbox in your tenant and its permission structure. We identify which shared mailboxes are still needed, document who has access and what kind, flag stale and excessive permissions, and clean up what you approve. You get a documented picture of your shared mailbox environment with the access risk removed - because a shared mailbox with the wrong people in it is a data leak waiting to happen.

Organizations that have had staff changes without permission cleanup
Companies concerned about who can read shared mailboxes
Businesses preparing for access reviews or compliance checks

Full Access, Send As, and Send on Behalf permission review
customerOutcomes: A complete inventory of shared mailboxes and who can access them

onedrive_and_sharepoint_permissions_revi.marketingCopy: External sharing, public links, and 'anyone with the link' permissions are how confidential business data quietly leaks - and most small businesses have no idea how widely their OneDrive and SharePoint content is shared. The OneDrive and SharePoint Permissions Review examines external sharing settings, public and 'anyone' links, guest access, and excessive user permissions across your environment. We identify files and sites that are more exposed than they should be, document the risks, and recommend or execute the fixes you approve. Your collaboration data gets its sharing posture reviewed and corrected before a leak happens.

departing_employee_lockdown.marketingCopy: A departing employee's account is a security risk the moment they leave - whether they leave on good terms or bad. We handle the account hygiene so you're not left wondering whether a former employee still has access to email, files, or apps. We also preserve important data - mailbox content, OneDrive files, and anything the business needs - before access is cut. The account is locked down fast, and the data is saved.
